Mercor is hiring Senior Software Engineers to work on a project with a leading AI research lab. You'll apply your open-source engineering experience to real software engineering work.

**You're a good fit if you:**

- Work as a Senior, Staff or Principal Software Engineer (or equivalent senior individual contributor)
- Actively contribute to open-source projects, with merged pull requests or commits in the last 6 months
- Maintain or contribute to projects with real adoption, such as 100+ GitHub stars or clear package usage
